attchmntText: Yatra Online Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Please find the enclosed herewith Press Release".
voiceSummary: Yatra Online Limited filed an intimation regarding its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. For the second quarter of fiscal year 2026-27, the company reported revenue of INR 2,136 million, a year-on-year decline of 39.1 percent. Adjusted EBITDA stood at INR 150 million, down 41.2 percent year-on-year. Net loss was recorded at INR 7 million. For the first half of fiscal year 2026-27, gross bookings reached INR 42,661 million, representing an 11 percent year-on-year increase. Revenue for the half year was INR 4,015 million, with adjusted EBITDA at INR 301 million. Net loss for the half year was INR 4 million. The company announced that an earnings conference call will be held on November 13, 2026, at 11:30 AM Indian Standard Time to discuss these results.

attchmntText: The Ruby Mills Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: The Ruby Mills Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 10,496.17 lakhs for the quarter and 19,644.39 lakhs for the half year. Profit for the period stood at 5,084.16 lakhs for the quarter and 6,266.65 lakhs for the half year. The board placed the appointment of Shri Siddharth S. Thacker as Additional Director and Independent Director for five years from November 12, 2026, subject to shareholder approval. Shri Rishabh Viraj Shah ceased as President on November 12, 2026. His appointment as Additional Director and Whole Time Director for three years is also subject to shareholder approval. Shri Sunil Kumar Tyagi was appointed Chief Operating Officer effective November 23, 2026.

attchmntText: Parag Milk Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about the Schedule of Analysts / Investors Meet

The company will participate in the Avendus Spark Conference on November 17, 2026. The event will be held in Mumbai and will include one-on-one and group meetings. The meeting is physical. The schedule may change due to exigencies. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared or discussed during the event. The intimation was submitted by Virendra Varma, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Please find the enclosed herewith Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Yatra Online Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the National Stock Exchange and BSE. The report, issued by ICRA Limited on November 12, 2026, confirms no deviation in the utilization of proceeds from the Initial Public Offer. The company raised net proceeds of INR 570.097 Crore. As of the quarter end, INR 500.631 Crore was utilized. Unutilized funds totaling INR 69.466 Crore were deployed in fixed deposits with Yes Bank, Unity Small Finance Bank, and IDFC Bank. The implementation of strategic investments and organic growth initiatives remains on schedule. The report is available on the company website at www.yatra.com.

attchmntText: Bhartiya International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of the Board Meeting   Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half-Year Ended September 30, 2026, and Statement of Assets and Liabilities and Cash Flow Statement for the Half-Year Ended September 30, 2026.'.
voiceSummary: Bhartiya International Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on 12th November 2026. The Board considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company submitted Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results along with a Limited Review Report to the National Stock Exchange of India and BSE Limited. The financial results indicate revenue of Rs. 506.9 crore for the second quarter of FY27, compared to Rs. 399.4 crore in the corresponding period of FY26. Profit After Tax for the quarter was Rs. 25.2 crore, up from Rs. 14.6 crore in the previous year. Half-year revenue stood at Rs. 879.7 crore against Rs. 679.4 crore in the prior year. The results are subject to publication in newspapers as per Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Indian Terrain Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Indian Terrain Fashions Limited filed an investor presentation regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 106.59 Cr, a 5.6% year-on-year increase. Gross margin stood at 40.8%. Operating EBITDA was Rs. 9.58 Cr with a 9.0% margin. Profit before tax was Rs. 2.92 Cr, compared to Rs. 1.15 Cr in the prior year. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue was Rs. 188.33 Cr, an 11.0% increase. Operating EBITDA was Rs. 15.66 Cr. Profit before tax was Rs. 3.06 Cr, marking a turnaround from a loss of Rs. 4.89 Cr in the previous half year. The company reported gross working capital improved by 26 days year on year to 300 days.

attchmntText: Delhivery Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 4,25,822 Equity Shares upon exercise of vested Options.

attchmntText: Integrated Financial Results for the Quarter ended 30-09-2026

attchmntText: Mahindra Holidays & Resorts India Limited has informed the Exchange about Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company
desc: Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company
voiceSummary: Mahindra Holidays and Resorts India Limited received a favourable order from the Madras High Court on 12th November 2026. The court accepted the company's accounting methodology for deferring receipts over the contract period for Assessment Years 2006-07 and 2007-08. This order reduces the company's contingent liability by Rs. 106 Crores. The order was received at 04:22 p.m. IST. The company disclosed this update under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The announcement references a previous letter dated 14th August 2023 regarding the pendency of the tax case appeal. Details are available in Annexure A and on the company website.

attchmntText: Som Distilleries & Breweries Limited has informed the Exchange about Commencement of commercial production/operations
voiceSummary: SOM Distilleries and Breweries Limited has commenced production and dispatches from its Bhopal manufacturing facility. This development marks a milestone in the restoration of the company's business operations and growth trajectory. The information was disclosed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The announcement was signed by Nakul Kam Sethi, Whole Time Director, with DIN 06512548. The details are available on the company website at www.somindia.com.

attchmntText: Kilitch Drugs (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Corrigendum to Notice of Extra Ordinary General Meeting to be held on November 16, 2026
voiceSummary: Kilitch Drugs India Limited issued a corrigendum to the Extra Ordinary General Meeting notice dated 22nd October 2026. The meeting is scheduled for 16th November 2026 at 9:00 A.M. via video conferencing. The correction addresses a typographical error in Item No. 2 regarding the allotment of additional shares. The number of equity shares to be allotted was incorrectly stated as 1,66,472. It is corrected to 1,66,471 equity shares of Kilitch Estro Biotech PLC. This allotment is pursuant to the conversion of outstanding debt. The corrected shareholding in the subsidiary will increase from 67% to 89.17%. The aggregate consideration for the sale remains USD 12,855,000. All other contents of the original notice remain unchanged. The corrigendum was dispatched on 12th November 2026.

attchmntText: Tata Capital Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 70300 securities pursuant to Non Convertible Securities at its meeting held on November 12, 2026
voiceSummary: Tata Capital Limited allotted Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures on November 12, 2026. The series is TCL Secured NCD G FY 2026-27-VIS-M. The company issued 70,300 securities with an issue size of Rs.703 crore. The ISIN is INE976I07DJ8. The coupon rate is 8.51% per annum. The tenor is 729 days from the date of allotment. The maturity date is November 10, 2028. The redemption amount is Rs.1,00,000 per NCD at face value. Interest is payable on November 12, 2027, and November 10, 2028. The debentures are secured by a pari-passu charge on moveable property. The credit rating is CRISIL AAA/Stable and ICRA AAA/Stable. The securities are proposed to be listed on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited.

attchmntText: Man Industries (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a revised press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Revised Press Release / Media Release for the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.".
voiceSummary: Man Industries India Limited filed a revised press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated EBITDA reached 190 crore, up 86.6% year-on-year, with consolidated PAT growing 121.7% to 82 crore. Consolidated revenue from operations rose 49.3% to 1,216 crore. The company reported a consolidated order book of approximately 3,500 crore. Revenue of approximately 320 crore was deferred due to shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. The acquisition of National Pipe Company contributed significantly to performance. The company announced progress on the Merino Shelters joint development agreement, expected cash flows of 700 to 800 crore over five to six years, and production timelines for the Jammu greenfield plant by April 2027. Operations at the Dammam facility are targeted for March 2027. A new HSAW pipe facility in the USA with a capacity of 350,000 MTPA and planned capex of US$110 million was also disclosed.

attchmntText: EIH Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
voiceSummary: EIH Limited approved the construction of a Trident five-star deluxe hotel near Shamshabad Airport, Hyderabad, during its Board Meeting on 12th November 2026. The project is situated on an 8.89-acre site owned by the Company. The estimated investment required is Rs. 777 crores. Financing will be through internal accrual and debt. The hotel is expected to be operational by September 2030. It will cater to domestic and international travelers. The initiative is part of the Company's portfolio expansion in the domestic tourism sector. The Board Meeting started at 04:00 p.m. and concluded at about 6.15 p.m. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Brooks Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating- Revision
voiceSummary: Brooks Laboratories Limited has received an upgrade in its credit ratings from CARE Ratings Limited. The long-term bank facilities rating is upgraded to CARE BB plus with a stable outlook, from CARE BB. The short-term bank facilities rating is upgraded to CARE A4 plus, from CARE A4. The upgrade follows the receipt of Rs. 106.33 crore from the partial divestment of its stake in Brooks Steriscience Limited. This capital infusion strengthens the company's liquidity and financial risk profile. Contingent liabilities have reduced to approximately Rs. 48.15 crore. Profit before interest, lease rentals, depreciation and taxation margin improved to 8.88 percent in FY26. The company plans to use the funds for capital expenditure. A proposed demerger of the manufacturing business into Abridge Speciality Limited is also noted.

attchmntText: Mayur Uniquoters Ltd has informed the Exchange about Disruption of Operations due to Fire Incident occurred at Line No.3 of Jaitpura Plant of the Company.
voiceSummary: Mayur Uniquoters Limited intimates that a fire incident occurred on November 12, 2026, at around 4:00 AM at Line No. 3 of its Jaitpura Plant in Jaipur. Emergency response was initiated, and the fire was brought under control with no injuries or casualties reported. Preliminary assessment indicates the loss is not expected to have a material impact on the Company. The exact quantum of loss and cause are being ascertained. Production activities at Line No. 3 were affected, but the overall impact on operations is expected to be minor. The Company has adequate insurance coverage for the affected assets and has initiated the claim process. Further material developments will be communicated to the exchanges.

attchmntText: VISA Chrome Limited has informed the Exchange about Scheme of Arrangement
voiceSummary: VISA Chrome Limited board meeting held on November 12, 2026 approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a loss of 21.94 crore for the quarter and 31.50 crore for the half year. Revenue from operations was 135.39 crore for the quarter. The auditor issued a review report highlighting material uncertainty regarding the company's ability to continue as a going concern due to accumulated losses, eroded net worth, and current liabilities exceeding current assets. The board granted in-principle approval for a scheme of arrangement to transfer the Raigarh Project undertaking to wholly-owned subsidiary Kalinganagar Chrome Private Limited. This scheme is subject to shareholder and creditor approval, regulatory observations, and National Company Law Tribunal sanction. The subsidiary is applying to change its name to VISA Steel Raigarh Private Limited.

voiceSummary: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited disclosed that B S R and Co, Statutory Auditors of its material subsidiary Prabal Motors Private Limited, resigned effective 11 November 2026. Outstanding convertible warrants will be adjusted to entitle holders to 12 shares of Rs. 5 each upon conversion. The record date for entitlements will be intimated separately.

attchmntText: The Grob Tea Company Limited has informed regarding ''Disclosure of Material Events pertains to the Company's Wholly Owned Subsidiary Company" under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: The Grob Tea Company Limited disclosed that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Bazaloni Group Limited, approved a capital expenditure of approximately Rs. 16 crore on 12th November 2026. The funds will finance the installation of Orthodox Tea Manufacturing Machinery at the subsidiary's facility. This project aims to expand manufacturing capacity and strengthen production infrastructure for the tea business. Implementation is expected by 30.04.2027. The expenditure will be financed through bank borrowings by Bazaloni Group Limited. No direct financial contribution is envisaged from The Grob Tea Company Limited. The investment is expected to enhance operational capabilities and contribute to the consolidated business operations of the parent company.

attchmntText: Praxis Home Retail Limited has informed the Exchange regarding outcome of the Committee of Directors Meeting held on November 12, 2026, pertaining to the approval of the terms of the Rights Issue, including the Record Date.
voiceSummary: Praxis Home Retail Limited’s Committee of Directors approved a rights issue of 10,32,29,005 fully paid-up equity shares at Rs. 5 per share, aggregating to Rs. 51,61,45,025. The record date is November 18, 2026. The entitlement ratio is 5 rights shares for every 9 existing shares held. The issue opens on November 27, 2026, and closes on December 04, 2026. Finalization of allotment and listing are expected on or about December 07, 2026. Outstanding shares prior to the issue stand at 18,58,12,210, rising to 28,90,41,215 post-issue assuming full subscription. The company has received in-principle approvals from BSE and NSE. The Letter of Offer will be dispatched to eligible shareholders on the record date.

attchmntText: IGL Spirits Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Amendment to AOA/MOA of the company.
voiceSummary: IGL Spirits Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the adoption of a new set of Articles of Association on 12th November 2026. The meeting commenced at 15.45 Hrs and concluded at 17.20 Hrs. The adoption aims to align the Articles with the Securities Contracts Regulation Rules 1957 and the group's governance framework. This change is subject to shareholder approval and any required regulatory or statutory approvals. The disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Agi Infra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: AGI Infra Limited has closed its trading window for dealing in company securities for all Designated Persons and their immediate relatives. This closure is effective from Thursday, November 12, 2026, and will remain in place until 48 hours after the determination of the Issue Price. The closure is in connection with the proposed Qualified Institutions Placement for which In-Principle Approval was received on November 12, 2026. The notice was issued by Aarti Mahajan, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The intimation was submitted to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited pursuant to SEBI regulations and the company's code of conduct. The notice is also available on the company website at www.agiinfra.com.

attchmntText: Gland Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange that Gland Pharma Limited ( Company ) has issued Corporate Guarantee on behalf of Phixen SAS, wholly owned step down subsidiary of the Company.
desc: Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party
voiceSummary: Gland Pharma Limited issued a corporate guarantee on behalf of its wholly owned step down subsidiary, Phixen SAS. The guarantee is provided to MUFG Bank Europe N.V. to secure a draw-down amount under a Uncommitted Revolving Facility Agreement. The facility is valued at Euro 50 Mn with an initial draw-down limit of Euro 18 Mn. Gland Pharma extended a corporate guarantee of EURO 20 Mn in favor of MUFG Bank. This guarantee secures the draw-down amount and interest thereon. The facility agreement is valid for 3 years. The corporate guarantee is valid until March 31, 2030. The company may extend the guarantee limit if draw-down limits for Phixen SAS increase in the future. The corporate guarantee is treated as a contingent liability for the company.

attchmntText: TD Power Systems Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 12, 2026, declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 0.65 per equity share.
voiceSummary: TD Power Systems Limited approved its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. The board declared an interim dividend of 65 percent, equivalent to Rs. 0.65 per equity share. Payment will occur within 30 days. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, net sales were Rs. 82,313.10 Lakhs. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 12,131.15 Lakhs. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, net sales were Rs. 1,45,097.29 Lakhs. Profit after tax was Rs. 20,777.51 Lakhs. The auditor issued a limited review report. The report notes a material uncertainty regarding the going concern status of the Indian subsidiary. This is not considered material to the group. The board meeting concluded at 4:00 PM on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Elgi Rubber Company Limited has informed the Exchange about reversal of interest receivable from overseas wholly owned subsidiaries recognized during the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Elgi Rubber Company Limited board approved the reversal of Rs.17.03 million interest receivable from overseas subsidiaries Elgi Rubber Company LLC USA and Borrachas e Equipamentos Elgi Ltda Brasil. This aims to reduce interest burden for the subsidiaries. The board also approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Statutory auditors issued an unmodified opinion. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs.7,091.39 lakhs. Profit after tax was a loss of Rs.3,137.84 lakhs. Earnings per share was Rs.6.27 loss. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs.12,934.76 lakhs. Profit after tax was Rs.1,185.16 lakhs. Earnings per share was Rs.2.37. The meeting was held on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Intimation of Approval of Name Reservation by the MCA update under Reg 30
voiceSummary: Tera Software Limited has received name reservation approval from the Ministry of Corporate Affairs for the new name Tera Corp Limited. The Central Registration Centre approved the reservation on November 11, 2026, with the letter received on November 12, 2026. The reservation is valid for 60 days under Section 4(5) of the Companies Act, 2013. The company states the change reflects its strategic pivot toward multi-domain flagship projects. The name change is subject to shareholder approval, in-principle approval from stock exchanges under Regulation 45 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, and final approval from the Registrar of Companies. The company confirms the change will not affect its legal status, constitution, core operations, or stakeholder rights. The company’s CIN is L72200TG1994PLC018391.

attchmntText: ICICI Securities Limited has submitted a copy of the Letter of Offer of IIFL Capital Services Limited to the Exchange.
voiceSummary: ICICI Securities Limited, acting as the manager to the open offer, disclosed that 45,35,712 equity shares, constituting 4.53% of the offer size, have been tendered in the open offer escrow demat account. The open offer is for the acquisition of up to 10,01,44,112 fully paid-up equity shares of face value of INR 2 each of IIFL Capital Services Limited by FIH Mauritius Investments Ltd along with HWIC Asia Fund. The tendered shares were received as per the open offer escrow demat account statement from Ventura Securities Limited as at 13:52:50 on November 12, 2026. The equity shares tendered by public shareholders are subject to validation and verification of the submission of a complete set of documents. The number of equity shares tendered may differ from the number of equity shares which will be accepted by the acquirer in the open offer.

attchmntText: Maithan Alloys Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of Equity Shares through Stock Exchange.
voiceSummary: Maithan Alloys Limited acquired 48,901 shares, representing 0.04% of ESDS Software Solution Limited, on 11th November 2026. The acquisition was completed through the stock exchange for a total cash consideration of Rs. 5.89 Crore. The event occurred at 3:30 P.M. on 11th November 2026. Maithan Alloys Limited does not intend to acquire control of the target entity. The acquisition is classified as an arms-length transaction and is not a related party transaction. ESDS Software Solution Limited is an IT-enabled services provider with a turnover of Rs. 378 Crore for the financial year ending 31st March 2026. The company acquired the shares for long-term or short-term investment benefits. No governmental or regulatory approvals were required for this transaction.

attchmntText: VRL Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about post Buyback Public Announcement
voiceSummary: VRL Logistics Limited submitted the post buyback public announcement to BSE Limited and NSE on November 12, 2026. The company executed a buyback of not exceeding 87,50,000 fully paid-up equity shares. Each share has a face value of Rs. 10. This represents 5% of the existing total paid-up equity capital. The buyback was conducted through the tender offer route. The price was Rs. 320 per equity share. The aggregate maximum amount did not exceed Rs. 28,000 Lakhs. The announcement was published in Financial Express, Jansatta, and Vijayavani on November 12, 2026. This filing complies with the Securities and Exchange Board of India Buyback Regulations, 2018.

attchmntText: The Exchange has sought clarification from Waaree Energies Limited with respect to recent news item captioned Waaree Energies to invest ?15,000 cr in green ammonia project in Andhra.  The response from the Company is attached.
voiceSummary: Waaree Energies Limited clarifies news regarding its wholly owned subsidiary, Waaree Clean Energy Solutions Private Limited, submitting an application for a proposed 1.2 million ton per annum green ammonia project in Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh. The Andhra Pradesh Government accorded approval via Government Order dated August 25, 2026. The formal handover of the order is scheduled for the 31st CII Partnership Summit in Visakhapatnam on November 12, 2026. The investment is subject to approval from the Internal Investment Committee and the Board of Directors of Waaree Energies Limited. The company states that share price movement is market driven and there is no unpublished price sensitive information pending disclosure. There are no regulatory or legal proceedings initiated in relation to this matter.

attchmntText: Bhagyanagar India Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating- Others
voiceSummary: Bhagyanagar India Limited intimates that ICRA Limited has assigned credit ratings to the bank facilities of its subsidiary, Tieramet Limited. The total rated amount is Rs. 654 Crore. The assigned rating is ICRA A- with a Stable outlook. The facilities include long-term fund-based bank facilities. The rating was assigned on November 11, 2026. Tieramet Limited is yet to list its equity shares. Listing applications with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited are under process. The company does not currently have access to stock exchange listing portals. The rating letter is enclosed with the intimation.

attchmntText: Ansal Properties & Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Delay in declaration of Un-Audited Financial Results for the 02nd Quarter/Half Year ended on the 30th September, 2026 of Financial year 2026-27 beyond the time frame stipulated under Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended.
desc: Reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial Results
voiceSummary: Ansal Properties and Infrastructure Limited has informed the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited of a delay in finalizing, approving, and declaring its Un-Audited Financial Results for the 02nd Quarter and Half Year ended on the 30th September, 2026, of Financial Year 2026-27. The results were due by the 14th November, 2026. The delay is attributed to the ongoing process of finalizing the Un-Audited Financial Results for the 01st Quarter ended on the 30th June, 2026, which was also delayed and previously reported on the 10th August, 2026. The Company states it is making all possible efforts to declare the results at the earliest. The Trading Window remains closed until 48 hours after the approval and declaration of the Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter ended on the 30th September, 2026. The letter was signed by Siddharth Goenka, Whole Time Director, with DIN 11524566.

attchmntText: CEAT Limited has informed the Exchange about Loss of Share Certificates
voiceSummary: CEAT Limited has intimated the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited regarding the loss of share certificates. The information was received from NSDL Database Management Limited, the Registrar and Transfer Agent. The notice pertains to Folio Number ZVA0001194 held by Ambalal Mohanlal Kayastha. The holder has lost or misplaced certificates for 11 shares of Rs. 10.00 each. The specific certificate numbers are 1523 and the distinctive numbers range from 2936751 to 2936761. The holder has applied to the company to issue duplicate certificates. The stock exchanges have been advised to place this notice for the attention of members. Investors are requested to communicate immediately if they have information regarding any transaction or the whereabouts of the original certificates. The notice was dated 11th November 2026.

attchmntText: Ester Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
desc: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
voiceSummary: Ester Industries Limited filed details of dematerialized shares for October 2026. The Registrar and Transfer Agent, Mas Services Limited, reported zero dematerialized and rematerialized shares for NSDL. For CDSL, there were 200 dematerialized shares and zero rematerialized shares. The total shares dematerialized under CDSL were 200. The company confirmed that all share certificates have been mutilated and cancelled. The filing was made pursuant to Regulation 74(5) of SEBI Depositories and Participants Regulations 2018. The report was signed by Poornima Gupta, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.
